summary: node1 now serves a signed local Alpine repository from /srv/local-apk over HTTP. figlet was installed from it while both usual remote repositories returned Connection refused. The configuration and package survived a verified node restart; Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created and signed an x86_64 APK repository containing figlet and its dependency.
Installed and executed figlet during a demonstrated upstream outage.
Configured APK to use only the local repository.
Restarted node1 and verified service, repository data, package, release, and kernel recovery.

evidence.summary: Shows indexed x86_64 APK artifacts, signed metadata, and the trusted node-generated public key.
Shows enabled/running lighttpd, port 80 listening, HTTP 200 retrieval through NODE_IP, and byte-identical index content.

evidence.requirement: Remote repositories unreachable during local installation
evidence.summary: Shows upstream unreachability and Connection refused for both standard repositories, followed by successful figlet installation and execution.

evidence.requirement: Persistent local repository and retained OS/kernel
evidence.summary: Shows the local-only APK source, signed update success, local figlet policy, Alpine 3.23.3, and unchanged 6.18.7-0-lts kernel.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 8a853f29-37f0-460b-9bc6-eb5b2a85aa35, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 6e9235fb-467c-4efc-98a8-17ad1e6d84e7, and recovered service, repository hashes, APK metadata, and installed package execution.
